name: The Road to Darnassus
summary: Along Teldrassil’s western road, corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs threaten the route from Dolanaar to Darnassus. Moon Priestess Amara coordinates scouts and travelers to keep this trade and messenger road clear of ambushes.

sections.title: A Lifeline Under Siege
sections.body: You travel west from Dolanaar toward Darnassus on Teldrassil’s main overland road. Trade goods, political messages, and travelers use it each day to stay connected with the capital and the boughs of the great tree. Teldrassil is young and wild, so safe roads matter to its kaldorei communities.

sections.title: The Gnarlpine Menace
sections.body: The Gnarlpine furbolgs of Teldrassil have fallen to a foul corruption. Driven mad by a sickness plaguing the boughs of the World Tree, they attack from hidden dens beneath the ridges. Gnarlpine ambushers stalk the tree line beside the road, preying on couriers and travelers and making the forest passage deadly.

sections.title: The Sentinels' Vigil
sections.body: Moon Priestess Amara watches over the road outside Dolanaar. She joins the spiritual authority of Elune’s priesthood with the Sentinels’ vigilance, directing capable travelers to strike at ambushers near their dens below the road. The safety of the route to Darnassus’s gates depends on keeping them at bay.

faq.q: Why is the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus so dangerous?
faq.answer: Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs have made dens along the low ridges below the road. The corruption spreading through Teldrassil has driven them mad, and they attack travelers, couriers, and merchants from the underbrush.

aliases: who gives the road to darnassus quest
faq.answer: Moon Priestess Amara, also addressed by her full name, Sentinel Amara Nightwalker, is a night elf commander stationed on Dolanaar’s western outskirts. She oversees the road’s security and coordinates efforts against the nearby Gnarlpine.

faq.q: Why are the Gnarlpine furbolgs aggressive?
faq.answer: Furbolgs were once peaceful allies and neighbors of the kaldorei. On Teldrassil, a strange malady infecting the World Tree has twisted the Gnarlpine, making them violent and driving them to attack anyone entering the forest.
The ambushers hide below the bluffs and vantage points just off the main road west of Dolanaar. Their dens let them leap upon travelers heading toward Darnassus.

faq.q: Why doesn't Darnassus send a full Sentinel garrison to clear the road?
faq.answer: The Sentinels are spread thin across Teldrassil, facing grell infestations, corrupted timberlings, and threats along the coast. Officers like Amara rely on capable travelers and volunteers to keep the interior roads clear.

faq.q: Why is Amara called both a Moon Priestess and a Sentinel?
faq.answer: In kaldorei society, Elune’s sisterhood and the Sentinel military are closely linked. Leaders in the priesthood often command Sentinel troops or have served as front-line warriors.

angles.text: The Gnarlpine were once honorable kindred of the wild. Putting down corrupted ambushers on the road to Darnassus is a grim necessity born of Teldrassil’s sickness.
As a priest, you aid Moon Priestess Amara and the Sisterhood of Elune, which gives spiritual leadership and martial defense to the young tree.
As an Alliance traveler, you help keep trade and messages moving safely along the main road to Darnassus, the heart of the Alliance presence in northern Kalimdor.
